reported.label: net sales ₹3,185 crore, up 23%
reported.quote: net sales in Q1 of FY26-'27 is INR3,185 crores against INR2,590 crores last year. Growth in net sales is 23%.

reported.label: EBITDA ₹415 crore, margin 13.04%
reported.quote: EBITDA in this quarter is INR415 crores against INR297 crores last year. Growth is around 39.5%. EBITDA/sales margin is 13.04%

reported.label: PAT ₹274 crore, up 40%
reported.quote: Profit after tax in this quarter is INR274 crores against INR195 crores. Growth in the PAT is 40%.

reported.label: domestic W&C sales ₹2,784 crore, up 29%
reported.quote: Domestic wire and cable sale in this quarter is INR2,784 crores and it has registered a growth of 29%.

reported.label: EHV sales ₹186 crore, up 47%
reported.quote: Total sales of extra high-voltage cable is INR186 crores against INR126 crores in the previous year same period. Growth in EHV sale is 47%.

reported.label: pending order book ₹4,292 crore
reported.quote: Pending order book is INR4,292 crores; out of which EPC is INR271 crores, extra high-voltage cable INR793 crores

reported.label: Q1 capex ₹191 crore, Sanand ₹180 crore
reported.quote: During Q1, the company has incurred a capital expenditure payment of INR191 crores, out of which Sanand capex is INR180 crores.

reported.label: Sanand Phase 1 at 50% utilization
reported.quote: Sanand Phase 1 capacity has already reached to 50% utilization as on today
